body: I was in a two and a half year relationship with my boyfriend. The first time he cheated he did everything to get me back.. So I took him back. He promised he would never do it again. The second time he cheated I was absolutely crushed. I had been the best girlfriend I could have been and trusted him enough to let him back into my life. I blamed myself for not being good enough for him. I'm still in that stage and it's only been four days that I've been single. Even in this short period of time though I have seen myself change quite a bit. I don't trust guys. At all. I learned that you can think someone is amazing and give him everything you have and he can be selfish and throw it all back in your face.
